observations: Photo 0 shows a motorcycle cockpit with two analog gauges (speedometer/tachometer) and a handlebar; brand text on the gauge cluster is not clearly readable.
Photo 1 shows the fuel tank/seat area with the word “Kawas…” visible on the tank (likely Kawasaki), but the full model name is not readable.
Photo 2 shows the front wheel and brake disc with a visible exhaust header/cylinder area; no model number or VIN is readable.

claims.claim: Kawasaki zzr power bike up for sales
claims.evidence: Only partial “Kawas…” text is visible on photo 1; “ZZR” is not readable in any photo.
No photo/video of the engine running, no dashboard warning check, no start-up sound/clip.
Seller’s reason is not verifiable from photos.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (seller says “ZZR”, but photos don’t clearly show ZZR model designation).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bike’s model badge/side fairing text and the registration/VIN plate (or engine/frame number) that shows “ZZR”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Kawasaki sport bike with unknown model/trim (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Non-running or hidden mechanical/electrical faults (claim “working fine” not proven).
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + idle (dashboard lights on, no warning indicators), and a 5–10 minute test ride clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Brake/tyre condition and safety issues (only front disc/wheel angle shown; tyre tread, brake pads/rotor wear not confirmed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre tread depth, brake pads/rotor thickness, and both front/rear brake calipers; plus a photo of tyre sidewall for date/size.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres/brakes may need service soon.

risks.risk: Body damage/repairs or corrosion (photos show road/usage; tank/seat and front area condition not fully visible).
risks.proof: Full side profile photos (both sides) and close-ups of any cracks, dents, repaint lines, and rust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming cosmetic wear and possible minor damage.

risks.risk: Exhaust/engine leak or missing parts (photo 2 shows exhaust/header area but not whether there are leaks or missing covers).
risks.proof: Close-up of exhaust joints (no soot leaks), engine area, and under-bike area; plus a running video showing no smoke/odd noises.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming exhaust/engine condition is not confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model badge/side fairing showing “ZZR” (or equivalent) and a photo of the registration/VIN plate.
Video of cold start and idle with dashboard warning lights visible (and no error indicators).
Test-ride video (5–10 minutes) showing smooth acceleration and braking.
Close-ups of tyres (tread + sidewall date), brake pads/rotors, and both sides of the bike.
response.reason: The photos only partially support “Kawasaki” and do not confirm the “ZZR” model, and the “working fine” claim is not proven with start/test footage. Without model identity and working proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
